name: Anna's Archive Book Search
author: OmniDesk
description: Searches Anna's Archive mirrors, inspects MD5 metadata, safely downloads verified ebooks via fast API or mirror links, and forwards to BabelDOC, EPUB reader, or Feiniu NAS.

config_schema.label: Anna's Archive 主站点地址
config_schema.description: Default public Anna's Archive endpoint (http/https only; no private hosts hardcoded)

config_schema.label: 自定义镜像 / API 地址（优先）
config_schema.description: Optional user-configured Anna's Archive mirror URL (takes priority over base_url)

config_schema.label: 本地下载根目录
config_schema.description: Explicitly configured local directory where downloaded books are atomically saved

config_schema.label: 单本下载大小上限 (MiB)
config_schema.description: Maximum allowed file size in MiB enforced before and during download

config_schema.label: 请求超时时间 (秒)
config_schema.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for search, detail, and download operations

config_schema.label: 会话 Cookie 来源
config_schema.description: Prefer web.cookies.v1 from plugin-chrome-web, then 0600 SecretVault credentials

config_schema.label: 优先使用 Chrome 同源代理 (web.fetch.v1)
config_schema.description: Route requests through web.fetch.v1 when available instead of direct HTTP

config_schema.label: Anna's Archive Secret Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Member secret key for /dyn/api/fast_download.json stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault

config_schema.label: 会话 Cookie（可选）
config_schema.description: Fallback Cookie header stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault

config_schema.label: 凭据所属站点
config_schema.description: 切换镜像时固定原站点凭据来源，避免把 Cookie / Key 发送到其他域名
